chat.create_smart_conv_category.review_reason: Expose the existing smart-category helper through the reviewed Agent Schema and preserve its CLI-to-interface parameter contract.

chat.list_message_favorites.review_reason: Preserve the reviewed CLI-to-interface conversion: Cobra validates --size as an integer from 1 to 100, then the helper serializes it to the string-valued list_message_favorites size property.

chat.list_owned_or_admin_groups.review_reason: The reviewed CLI lists all owned or administered groups when --role and --limit are omitted; both flags are optional filters despite stricter imported interface metadata.

chat.remove_emoji_reaction.review_reason: The four reviewed conversation locator flags are aliases for one openConversationId property; the typed require-one-of constraint owns their conditional requirement.

chat.remove_text_emotion.review_reason: The four reviewed conversation locator flags are aliases for one openConversationId property; the typed require-one-of constraint owns their conditional requirement.

chat.set_group_member_mute_list.review_reason: The reviewed Cobra contract makes --off an optional mode switch: omission adds members to the mute list, while --off removes them. The shared MCP schema incorrectly marks the boolean as unconditionally required.

chat.set_group_mute.review_reason: The reviewed optional --off switch selects unmute; omission deliberately selects mute, so false is a valid default rather than missing required input.

chat.set_top_conversation.review_reason: The reviewed optional --off switch selects unpin; omission deliberately selects pin, so false is a valid default rather than missing required input.

chat.update_conv_member_roles.review_reason: The reviewed optional --off switch selects administrator removal; omission deliberately selects administrator assignment.

chat.update_notification_off.review_reason: The reviewed locator aliases feed one openConversationId property, while optional --off selects unmute; typed constraints require one locator without making the mode switch mandatory.

chat.edit_message.review_reason: The reviewed handler requires one conversation locator, a message ID, and exactly one of text or raw content; it optionally derives a title and maps mention controls before invoking edit_message.

chat.get_conv_categories_info.review_reason: The reviewed handler requires a comma-separated category-ID list, parses it to integers, and invokes get_conv_categories_info without a mutation or confirmation gate.

chat.list_conv_categories_by_conv.review_reason: The reviewed handler accepts one of three conversation locator aliases and invokes list_conv_categories_by_conv without a mutation or confirmation gate.

chat.update_group_nick.review_reason: The reviewed handler requires the target conversation while intentionally allowing omitted --nick to send an empty nickname and clear the current user's group nickname.

chat.upgrade_group_to_external.review_reason: The reviewed handler validates the target group and optional string-valued extension object, permits caller-authoritative dry-run, and requires explicit --yes before the irreversible upgrade.

chat.shortcut_messages_send_card.review_reason: Reviewed against authenticated contact-search resolution, create-only, two-action dry-run, create/update success, missing bizId, and partial-failure behavior that preserves the created bizId; the explicit openDingTalkId flag is bound to the lower interface's exact receiverOpenDingTalkId property.

chat.update_text_emotion.review_reason: Ported from dws-wukong commits d6831318 and bcf56ccf, merged at 30f13f02. The four conversation locators alias one property; the other six business parameters are required by Cobra before the single im/update_text_emotion call.
